chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
“Every bird that does not glide is in the same category as chicken.”

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the status or category of
key_terms.يَصُفَّ: to glide or soar with outspread wings in flight

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on birds that do not glide in flight according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal criterion concerning birds by classifying those that do not glide in flight as being like chickens. It serves as a jurisprudential indicator in determining rulings related to lawful bird species.
